title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title displayed at the top of the tooltip.

hideArrow.name: Hide Arrow
hideArrow.description: When true, hides the tooltip arrow.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

side.name: Side
side.description: The side of the trigger the tooltip appears on.

align.name: Align
align.description: Alignment of the tooltip relative to the trigger.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Theme variant of the tooltip. 'default' uses high-contrast fixed colors; 'themed' follows the current theme palette.
